warn_confirm.note: WARN+CONFIRM depends on the unknown compliance rate c; only the analytic sweep is reported. c=0 equals plain_warn, c=1 equals block.

confirm_vs_mask.reading: None means no WARN prompt exposes an intact span. A value above 1 means even universal cancellation cannot reach WARN+MASK's exposure; a value below 0 means MASK is worse than plain WARN. Analytic, depends on the unknown compliance rate.

mask_vs_plain_warn.mask_exposure_bound: WARN+MASK exposure is bounded by detector span recall: a gold span that no predicted span fully covers is transmitted (partly or fully intact), and prompts the pipeline ALLOWs are never touched.

warn_subset.note: Sensitive prompts the pipeline WARNs: the only prompts these interventions can change. ALLOW prompts are detector misses and BLOCK prompts are already not sent.
